mainEntity.name: How much loan can I get based on my salary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your loan eligibility depends on your monthly income, existing EMIs, interest rate and loan tenure. Banks usually allow up to 50% of your income towards EMIs.

mainEntity.name: What is FOIR in loan eligibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio) is the percentage of your income used to pay existing loans and EMIs. A lower FOIR increases your loan eligibility.

mainEntity.name: Does existing EMI affect loan eligibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Existing EMIs reduce your available income for a new loan, which lowers the maximum loan amount you can get.

mainEntity.name: Is this loan eligibility calculator accurate?

acceptedAnswer.text: This calculator provides an estimate based on standard banking rules. Final eligibility may vary depending on bank policies and your credit score.
